notes.title: a7.8.4 - Bug Fixes, Class Roles, and Footsteps!
notes.notes:
Here’s a list of the changes that have been made in this update:


Bug Fixes:

Fixed bug with AR-15 appearing pitch black.

Fixed bug where crafting menu blocked the inventory screen.

Fixed issue where the Tablet class couldn't cycle the GPS display on the top screen.

Fixed back button being offscreen on the lobby screen.

Fixed various object scaling issues.

Fixed multiple UI scaling issues across different resolutions.

Fixed missing colliders on several objects (notably cars).

Fixed resolution being locked at 1024x768.

Fixed bug where collected guns wouldn’t appear on the Hunter’s hotbar.

Fixed camera TV not being able to switch feeds in singleplayer mode.

New Additions & Improvements:

Added class identifiers: Jack the Cameraman, Dana the Hunter, and Nigel the Tracker.

Added a new dynamic, networked footstep system.

Player roles are now assigned by order:

Player 1 = Hunter

Player 2 = Camera

Player 3 = Tracker

Max players in lobby reduced to 3 (from 4) to reflect current class design.

Updated engine version from Unity 2022.3 to Unity 6.0 for better performance and future support.

Coming Next:

Full character voice lines and banter.

New map and monster.

AI pathfinding rework. Switching from A* back to Unity's Navmesh system.

More polish and balance changes based on your feedback.

-NOTE: I understand I mentioned these things will be in the next update, but a few bugs and QOL changes took priority. What is mentioned in Coming Next will be in the next update (a7.8.5).

Thanks again for playing! As always, your feedback helps shape the game — so keep it coming. See you out there, and happy hunting!

notes.title: a7.8.2 Patch
notes.notes:
This is a small patch that just addresses some major input issues in the game. These issues were causing delay and unresponsiveness to inputs.


Mouse smoothing is completely removed. You can expect an instant response to your inputs now.

Weapon rotation lag is no longer extreme. It is now optimized for each weapon and operates smoother and more responsively.

Aiming delay is removed entirely. Aiming is instant, as well as aim down sights on the weapons has been optimized.

Thanks.

notes.title: a7.8.0 Update | New Score System, New Character Classes, and More!
notes.notes:
Truth Seekers - a7.8.0 Update Patch Notes

New Content & Features:

New Scoring System Implemented!
[olist]
Meat on Trap: +5 points
Monster Hit by Trap: +50 points
Harvest Wolf: +15 points
Monster Hit by Bullet: +10 points

Camera Recorded Monster: +10 points per second
Tracked Monster: +25 points
[/olist]

New Playable Classes!

Hunter – Equipped with a brand-new shotgun for better firepower.

New Features & Improvements


Added stats page to track individual performance.
Added identifying text below each inventory and hotbar item.
Added variable pitch for monster screaming SFX for more variety.
Added new blood particle effects for improved visual feedback.
Extended monster hunt duration (waypoints increased from 13 to 20).
Added 4:3 resolution support for better compatibility with older displays.
Score breakdown now shows each player's contribution on the win/lose screen.
Tutorial menu rewritten to better explain character roles and game objectives.


Fixes & Optimizations

Fixed monsters getting stuck while running at players during attack cycles. (New 30-second max attack timer added).
Fixed wolves not despawning after being harvested.
Monster AI tweaks for smoother pathing.
UI & Sound Improvements
Fixed new UI scaling issues across different resolutions.
Tons of UI fixes for better clarity and usability.
Added pickup sounds for all items.
Networking & Stability
Fixed cameras not working after placing five.
Fixed score only updating for master client—now properly syncs across all players.
Fixed loading screen not feeding correct level data to clients.
Fixed handheld camera view distance to ensure proper footage capture.
Fixed random crashes when loading a second time into a match.
Fixed retry load scene not working for clients.
Over 30+ miscellaneous bug fixes for improved stability.


This update brings new gameplay depth, better balance, and tons of quality-of-life fixes. You may encounter bugs with the new features. Please report all the bugs in the settings menu under the bug report option, or join the discord! My DM's and general chat are always open! Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Delayed Release Information
notes.notes:
The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
A few things happened just before launch that have led to a delay. Here are the steps I'm taking to resolve the issues and release in the coming week.

The Bad

I'm starting with the bad news: the game launch has been delayed from October 31st. Due to issues with the content survey, the game was blocked in certain parts of the world. I've been working with Steam to resolve this and ensure everything is ready for a smooth launch.

The Ugly

I'm not exactly sure of the exact launch date yet, but I can confirm it will be in the first week of November. Thanks for sticking with us, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

The Good

This is the best part of the update! The game is now ready for its Early Access launch! I also want to highlight an important feature that will be available on launch day:

Demo players and full-version players can play together on the Whispering Pines Wilderness map. Demo users have access to all features, but they are limited to that map only.


All features are fully functional, and after some closed testing, I can confirm that the new map is incredibly fun!

Thank you all for your patience and support as I work to bring this game to life. I'm excited for you to experience everything I've put into the Early Access launch, especially the Whispering Pines Wilderness map that allows both demo and full-version players to team up and explore together. I can’t wait to hear your feedback and see you in-game soon. Stay tuned for the official launch date and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!

notes.title: Mark Your Calendars, The Release Date Is Now Official!
notes.notes:
Exciting News, Truth Seekers!

I am thrilled to announce that Truth Seekers will officially launch into Early Access on October 31st, 2024! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into the mysteries and hunt down urban legends on Halloween!

First, I want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who participated in the Steam Next Fest demo and others who are currently participating. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and it’s because of your support that I’m able to keep pushing the game forward. As a solo developer, hearing from players like you gives me the insight I need to create the best possible experience.

Why Early Access?

As a solo developer, I’ve chosen to launch Truth Seekers in Early Access so that I can work closely with all of you to fine-tune and perfect the game. With your help, I’ll be able to find and fix bugs, improve gameplay, and polish the mechanics before the full release. Your involvement is crucial in shaping the final version, and I’m excited to collaborate with the community to ensure Truth Seekers reaches its full potential.

There’s also more content to come! This Early Access launch is just the beginning. I have a lot of exciting features, hunts, and secrets planned for future updates. Your feedback during Early Access will help guide the direction of the game and ensure it evolves into something even more special.

Sneak Peek
And lastly, I wanted to leave you all with a screenshot from the new map that will be released when the game goes into early access. Welcome to Frostpeak Summit Sanctuary! Who knows what creatures could be lurking around...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982220/f7820c0c5e12432ea3525456e7506f6c73c20669.jpg

Thank you again for your ongoing support, and I can’t wait for you to experience Truth Seekers when it launches on October 31st!

Stay tuned for more updates, and I’ll see you in the hunt!
